# 1 Samuel Chapter 7 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 153v--154r | **Source Image:** 1SA_007_page_001.jpg, 1SA_007_page_002.jpg

---

**7:1** And-came [the]-men of-Kiriath-jearim and-they-brought-up the-ark of-YHWH, and-they-brought it unto [the]-house of-Abinadab on-the-hill, and-Eleazar his-son they-consecrated to-keep the-ark of-YHWH.

**7:2** And-it-was from-the-day [the]-ark dwelt in-Kiriath-jearim, and-multiplied the-days, and-they-were twenty years. And-lamented all [the]-house of-Israel after YHWH.

**7:3** And-said Samuel unto all [the]-house of-Israel, saying, \"If with-all your-heart you-[are]-returning unto YHWH, remove the-gods of-the-foreign-ones from-your-midst, and-the-Ashtaroth [*ashtarot*], and-establish your-hearts unto YHWH and-serve him alone, and-he-will-deliver you from-[the]-hand of-[the]-Philistines.\"

**7:4** And-removed [the]-sons of-Israel the-Baalim and-the-Ashtaroth, and-they-served YHWH alone.

**7:5** And-said Samuel, \"Gather all Israel to-Mizpah, and-I-will-pray for-you unto YHWH.\"

**7:6** And-they-gathered to-Mizpah, and-they-drew water and-they-poured-[it]-out before YHWH, and-they-fasted on-that-day, and-they-said there, \"We-have-sinned against-YHWH.\" And-judged Samuel the-sons of-Israel at-Mizpah.

**7:7** And-heard [the]-Philistines that had-gathered [the]-sons of-Israel to-Mizpah, and-went-up [the]-lords of-[the]-Philistines against Israel. And-heard [the]-sons of-Israel, and-they-were-afraid from-before [the]-Philistines.

**7:8** And-said [the]-sons of-Israel unto Samuel, \"Do-not be-silent from-us, from-crying unto YHWH our-God, and-he-will-save-us from-[the]-hand of-[the]-Philistines.\"

**7:9** And-took Samuel one lamb, a-suckling, and-he-offered-it-up [as] a-whole-burnt-offering to-YHWH. And-cried-out Samuel unto YHWH for Israel, and-answered-him YHWH.

**7:10** And-was Samuel offering-up the-burnt-offering, and-[the]-Philistines drew-near for-battle against Israel. And-thundered YHWH with-a-great voice on-that-day upon the-Philistines, and-he-confused-them, and-they-were-struck before Israel.

**7:11** And-went-out [the]-men of-Israel from-Mizpah and-they-pursued the-Philistines, and-they-struck-them unto below Beth-car.

**7:12** And-took Samuel one stone and-he-set [it] between Mizpah and-between the-Shen, and-he-called its-name Even-ha-Ezer [*Ebenezer*, lit. \"Stone-of-the-Help\"], and-he-said, \"Until here YHWH has-helped-us.\"

**7:13** And-were-subdued the-Philistines, and-not they-continued again to-come into-[the]-border of-Israel. And-was [the]-hand of-YHWH against-the-Philistines all [the]-days of-Samuel.

**7:14** And-were-returned the-cities which [the]-Philistines had-taken from-Israel to-Israel, from-Ekron and-unto Gath, and-their-border Israel delivered from-[the]-hand of-[the]-Philistines. And-there-was peace between Israel and-between the-Amorites.

**7:15** And-judged Samuel Israel all [the]-days of-his-life.

**7:16** And-he-went from-year to-year, and-he-went-around Beth-el and-the-Gilgal and-the-Mizpah, and-he-judged Israel [in] all these-places.

**7:17** And-his-return [was to] the-Ramah, for there [was] his-house, and-there he-judged Israel, and-he-built there an-altar to-YHWH.

---
## EMET\\\'s Textual Notes

1. **7:2 -- \"and-lamented all the house of Israel after YHWH\":** The verb וַיִּנָּהוּ (wayyinnahu) from נהה, \"to lament/wail.\" Some interpret this as \"turned\" or \"sought after\" (cf. LXX ἐπέβλεψεν), but the MT form is clearly from the root for lamentation. The sense is that Israel mourned in longing for YHWH during the twenty years of Philistine dominance.

2. **7:3 -- *Ashtarot* (Ashtaroth):** Plural of Ashtoreth, the Canaanite fertility goddess. The pairing of Baalim (male deities) and Ashtaroth (female deities) is a stock phrase for foreign worship in the Deuteronomistic history.

3. **7:6 -- \"they drew water and poured it out\":** This ritual of water-pouring is unique in the Hebrew Bible. It may represent a libation of repentance or symbolize the pouring out of the heart before YHWH (cf. Lam 2:19).

4. **7:9 -- \"one lamb, a suckling\" (*taleh ehad halav*):** The term חָלָב (halav) -- Ketiv spelling, literally \"milk\" -- refers to a nursing/suckling lamb. The term underscores the lamb\\\'s innocence and youth as a whole offering.

5. **7:12 -- *ha-Shen*:** Lit. \"the Tooth\" or \"the Crag.\" A place name otherwise unattested. The Leningrad Codex reads הַשֵּׁן. The LXX reads \"Jeshanah\" (τῆς παλαιᾶς). EMET preserves the MT.

6. **7:16 -- Circuit of Samuel:** The three locations -- Bethel, Gilgal, Mizpah -- form a judicial circuit in Benjaminite territory. This itinerant judging pattern echoes the judges period now closing.

-- EMET
